verdict.rationale: Metorial documents two ways to plug in MCP servers. You can link a remote MCP server and use it like any other provider, or upload your own MCP server code for Metorial to host. Tools from multiple attached providers are merged into one session and exposed to your AI, with tool filters to control which are available. The GitHub README separately lists custom MCP servers among its 1200+ integrations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that linking a remote or custom MCP server works end-to-end.
